selection_criteria: I. Viabilidad de la propuesta - 50% (estado del arte, justificacion y nuevos aportes, objetivos generales y especificos, consistencia de la metodologia: 12.5% cada subcriterio)
II. Experiencia del postulante - 30% (experiencia general en investigacion 10%, grants ganados 10%, publicaciones en revistas cientificas 5%, presentaciones en congresos 5%)
III. Factibilidad - 10% (capacidad de completar el proyecto durante los tres anos de estudios doctorales)
IV. Fortaleza de la supervision de tesis - 10% (idoneidad de los co-directores para dirigir la tesis)
Evaluacion por expertos independientes designados por el IRD en escala 0 a 5; calificacion minima aprobatoria de 3.0 puntos, considerandose aprobada la propuesta con promedio igual o mayor a 3
El Directorio establece un orden de merito para los cinco postulantes aptos, permitiendo que el siguiente acceda si el primero tiene algun impedimento

application_method: Enviar la documentacion en PDF al correo becas-posgrado@pucp.pe con el asunto: 'Escuela Doctoral Franco Peruana en Ciencias de la Ingenieria y Geociencias 2026'
Descargar de la pagina de la convocatoria el Formato Excel oficial de postulacion (Formato-Postulacion-EDFPCIG-2026-VF) y la Carta de Compromiso (Carta-de-Compromiso-EDFPCIG-2026-VF)
No se aceptara ningun documento, propuesta o solicitud posterior a la fecha y hora de cierre; las bases recomiendan enviar con anticipacion y verificar el funcionamiento de la red y el computador
official.application_route: Email one complete PDF dossier to becas-posgrado@pucp.pe with the prescribed subject line before 15 October 2026; there is no online portal.
official.study_mode: Presencial y a tiempo completo (in person, full-time)
official.international_eligibility: No - the call is restricted to Peruvian nationals. A foreign master's degree is accepted only if the awarding institution is duly registered with SUNEDU; if it is not yet registered, it must be registered within the 12 months following the signature of the commitment contract, should the applicant be selected.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Las postulaciones deben estar vinculadas a las tematicas en Ciencias de la Ingenieria y Geociencias: Geociencias, Energia, Medioambiente o Ciencias afines. The French-year research stay must take place in a French partner university of an IRD joint research unit (unidades mixtas de investigacion).
official.research_requirement: Propuesta de Tesis de Estudio Doctoral de maximo cinco paginas (Anexo 6) con titulo, postulante, co-directores de tesis frances y peruano con sus datos de contacto, resumen, introduccion/antecedentes, objetivos/hipotesis, materiales y metodos, resultados preliminares, cronograma que defina el primer ano en la PUCP, el segundo ano en la universidad francesa y el tercer ano en la PUCP, y maximo 20 referencias bibliograficas.
official.duration: Tres anos (36 meses): primer ano de tesis doctoral en la PUCP; segundo ano de estancia de investigacion de un ano calendario en una universidad francesa contraparte de la unidad mixta del IRD; tercer ano de tesis doctoral en la PUCP.
official.description: La Escuela Doctoral Franco-Peruana en Ciencias de la Ingenieria y Geociencias (EDFPCIG) es una estructura de investigacion para la formacion de doctores en la que participan investigadores con un record de excelencia en investigacion de instituciones peruanas y francesas. The call funds one doctoral scholarship, financed by the EDFPCIG members (Embajada de Francia en el Peru, IRD, PUCP), for a three-year thesis developed alternately in Peru and France under a co-tutela or co-direccion agreement.
official.program_type: Beca doctoral binacional bajo modalidad de co-tutela o de co-direccion (PUCP y universidad francesa asociada al IRD)

verification.notes: Amount (EUR 39,576 total over 36 months, split EUR 10,260 / 19,056 / 10,260), coverage, deadlines, eligibility, documents and evaluation criteria were read directly from the PUCP Escuela de Posgrado page and the official Bases document (BASES-completas-Beca-EDFPCIG-Convocatoria-2026) on the same official domain; the two agree exactly. The page labels the amounts 'sujeto a modificacion' (subject to change) and lists the 2026 call as open. No English language requirement is published anywhere on the official pages.

applicant_utility.summary: One single doctoral scholarship is on offer for the 2026 call: a three-year Peru-France PhD funded with a EUR 39,576 stipend (EUR 10,260 in each Peru year and EUR 19,056 for the French year), PUCP tuition and degree fees, a round-trip economy airfare for the France stay, accident and complementary insurance, social security access and French-language study. Applications close on 15 October 2026 and results are published on 4 December 2026, so the whole contest is decided in under eight weeks. Eligibility is deliberately narrow: Peruvian nationality, under 40 at the closing date, and a master's degree from a SUNEDU-registered institution in engineering or geoscience fields, tied to one of four priority themes (geosciences, energy, environment, related sciences). The practical bottleneck is not paperwork - the dossier is a single email - but locking in a French and a Peruvian co-director who will sign the commitment letters early, since the proposal is scored 10% on the strength of that supervision.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A Peruvian master's graduate under 40 in geosciences, energy, environmental science or a related engineering field who already has, or can quickly secure, a French IRD-linked supervisor and a PUCP co-director for a three-year split PhD.
application_readiness_checklist: Email perou@ird.fr (IRD representation in Peru) and becas-posgrado@pucp.pe in July or August, not September, to identify an IRD joint-unit laboratory for the French year and a PUCP supervisor - the commitment letters hinge on their reply time.
Confirm your master's degree is registered with SUNEDU before applying; if it is not, plan to register it within 12 months of signing the commitment contract once selected.
Draft the five-page thesis proposal (Anexo 6) with both co-directors named and their contact details, and a year-by-year schedule showing which French laboratory hosts year two.
Complete the official Excel application form and both commitment letters exactly as published, then scan the signed documents - a pasted signature image is rejected.

Send the whole dossier as PDF in one email early in the window: the bases explicitly warn that nothing is accepted after the closing date and hour and advise testing your network and computer beforehand.

Once the 4 December 2026 result is out, register for the PUCP doctoral 2027-1 admission without delay (early-payment discount closes 11 December 2026) because the stipend is only disbursed after admission is proved and your bank account and CCI are supplied.
common_rejection_risks: Missing or unsigned co-director commitment letters: the French (Anexo 3) and Peruvian (Anexo 4) letters are core documents, and without both supervisors the proposal cannot be scored on the 10% supervision criterion.
Falling below the 3.0/5 threshold with IRD-appointed external experts - external evaluation is 50% proposal viability, so a thin state-of-the-art or weak methodology drags the average down.
A thin track record: grants won (10%), publications (5%) and conference presentations (5%) are separately weighted, so applicants with none of these start well behind.
An ineligible degree: a master's from an institution not registered with SUNEDU, or a bachelor's-only file, is ruled out at the PUCP eligibility screen.
Formal defects: proposals longer than five pages, more than 20 references, unsigned annexes, or signature images copied and pasted into signed documents.
A proposal outside the four priority themes, or no French host laboratory identified for the second year.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The stipend is a fixed total for accommodation, food and local mobility, so supporting a family, any travel beyond the single round-trip economy fare to France, and anything beyond the personal-accident cover and the reimbursed complementary insurance stay on the scholar. Visa cost, Etudes en France fees, CVEC and French registration fees are waived, and PUCP tuition and degree fees are paid - but the official page labels the stipend 'sujeto a modificacion' (subject to change), so budget conservatively.
document_audit: Degree documents must be legalised copies (copia legalizada); plain photocopies are not accepted, and if the master's is not yet awarded you must attach the proof-of-processing certificate (constancia de tramite) from your university's registry or degrees office.
The master's thesis may be sent as PDF or a repository link - a dead or password-protected link is a real risk if reviewers cannot open it.
The descriptive CV (Anexo 5) must cover only the last five years of publications, projects and events, in the exact structure the template prescribes, including language levels.
The proposal is capped at five pages and 20 references - exceed either and you fail a formal requirement, and the timetable inside it must show the PUCP/France/PUCP year split.

The French co-director letter states whether the signatory is 'habilitado a dirigir tesis doctorales' (authorised to supervise doctoral theses) - have them confirm that line before signing, and note the template is signed by the head of the laboratory, centre or institute that will host the work.
alerts: Only one scholarship is awarded in the 2026 call; the Directorio keeps a five-name merit order, so a runner-up can still be funded if the winner cannot sign the commitment.
The window is 16 July to 15 October 2026 with no late submissions accepted - there is no grace period for email or network problems on the closing day.

Stipend instalments follow a schedule, currency and bank account agreed in a separate commitment contract with the PUCP, and disbursement only begins after you prove admission to the PUCP doctoral programme and provide the account number and CCI.
Doctoral studies are full-time and in person, and during the three funded years the only extra activity admitted is teaching a maximum of one course.
The published timetable can change: the bases state that any update to the cronograma is published on the EDFPCIG page, so re-check it before submitting.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One email with the complete PDF dossier goes to becas-posgrado@pucp.pe under the prescribed subject line; PUCP screens eligibility, IRD experts score the proposal, the Directorio names the winner and runner-up on 27 November 2026, and the result is published on the EDFPCIG page on 4 December 2026.
